history.new: No magma of order 8 or 10 satisfies x = y(((yx)x)y) (ETP equation 1313). With CLM-C05-07, the ETP notes and EXP-C05-06 (DRUP-certified gaps at 2, 3, 4, 6), the orders n <= 10 of finite models of 1313 are exactly 1, 5, 7 and 9.
history.old: No magma of order 8 or 10 satisfies x = y(((yx)x)y) (ETP equation 1313). With CLM-C05-07, the ETP notes and EXP-C05-03, the orders n <= 10 of finite models of 1313 are exactly 1, 5, 7 and 9.
history.reason: Skeptic review of batch 1.1 (reviews/skeptic_batch1.1.md, section 2) - upheld with a correction: the gaps 2, 3, 4, 6 are certified by EXP-C05-06, not EXP-C05-03 (solver results only); independent re-decision recorded

history.new: computer-assisted - the CNFs of the case split of proofs/paper/C05.md Lemma 8 (written proof), with the implied division clauses of Lemma 9 (written) and Latin rows (Lean: law1313_left_bijective) and Latin columns (Lean: law1313_right_bijective), are all UNSAT, each refuted by a DRAT proof from CaDiCaL 1.5.3 that drat-trim verified (45 + 97 CNFs; EXP-C05-08); the controls at n = 5, 6, 7 agree with EXP-C05-03; independently re-decided by the Skeptic with its own encoding written from scratch and DRAT proofs verified by drat-trim, and all 401 CNFs of EXP-C05-08 rebuilt with matching hashes (skeptic-reviewed 2026-10-19, reviews/skeptic_batch1.1.md section 2) - order 8 is UNSAT even without symmetry breaking (Latin square only); orders 8 and 10 with the Skeptic's split, 45 + 97 cases UNSAT
